statements: Prophet Sulayman was a king as well as a prophet.
Prophet Dawud was given the Zabur.
Prophet Sulayman was given the Zabur.
easy.explain: The Zabur was given to Dawud, the father of Sulayman.

statements: Prophet Yunus was swallowed by a great fish.
Prophet Ayyub is known for his patience.
Prophet Ayyub was swallowed by a great fish.
easy.explain: That was Yunus. Ayyub is remembered for patience through severe illness and loss.

statements: Adam was the first human being.
Muhammad ﷺ is the final prophet.
Adam was the final prophet.
easy.explain: Adam, ʿalayhi al-salām, was the first. Muhammad ﷺ is the seal of the prophets.

statements: The Qur'an is divided into 30 ajza.
Many people read one juz a night in Ramadan.
The Qur'an is divided into 30 surahs.
easy.explain: The Qur'an has 114 surahs. It is the juz divisions that number thirty.

statements: Jannah is the reward of the believers.
Jahannam is a place of punishment.
Jannah is a place of punishment.
easy.explain: Jannah is paradise; Jahannam is the Fire.

statements: Iblis refused to prostrate to Adam.
Iblis was of the jinn.
Iblis was one of the angels.
easy.explain: The Qur'an states explicitly that Iblis was of the jinn. Angels do not disobey what they are commanded.

statements: SubhanAllah is a phrase of remembrance.
Alhamdulillah means all praise is for Allah.
Alhamdulillah means Allah is the Greatest.
easy.explain: Allahu akbar means Allah is the Greatest. Alhamdulillah is praise.

statements: A hafiz has memorised the whole Qur'an.
The imam leads the prayer.
A hafiz is someone who leads the prayer.
easy.explain: A hafiz is a memoriser of the Qur'an. Leading the prayer is the role of the imam, though a hafiz often does so.

statements: Halal means permitted.
Haram means forbidden.
Halal means forbidden.
easy.explain: Halal is the permitted and haram the forbidden — the two are opposites.

statements: Prophet Harun was the brother of Musa.
Prophet Isma'il was a son of Ibrahim.
Prophet Harun was a son of Ibrahim.
easy.explain: Harun was the brother of Musa, many generations after Ibrahim.

statements: The mihrab shows the direction of prayer.
The minbar is used for the sermon.
The minbar shows the direction of prayer.
easy.explain: The mihrab is the niche marking the qiblah; the minbar is the pulpit.

statements: Zakat al-Fitr is given before the Eid prayer.
Zakat al-Mal is calculated on wealth.
Zakat al-Fitr is calculated on wealth.
easy.explain: Zakat al-Fitr is a fixed amount per person. Zakat al-Mal is the one calculated against wealth and the nisab.

statements: Tayammum uses clean earth.
Tayammum is used when water is unavailable.
Tayammum is performed with water.
easy.explain: Tayammum is specifically the dry alternative to wudu, used when water is unavailable or harmful.

statements: Prophet Isa was given the Injil.
Prophet Musa was given the Tawrat.
Prophet Isa was given the Tawrat.
easy.explain: The Tawrat was given to Musa and the Injil to Isa, ʿalayhim al-salām.

statements: Qiyam is the standing position in prayer.
Sujud is prostration.
Qiyam is prostration.
easy.explain: Qiyam is standing; sujud is prostration.

statements: Prophet Nuh's people were destroyed by a flood.
Prophet Nuh built an ark.
Prophet Nuh's people were destroyed by an earthquake.
easy.explain: The punishment of Nuh's people was the flood, from which those with him in the ark were saved.

statements: Istighfar is seeking forgiveness.
Takbir is saying Allahu akbar.
Istighfar is saying Allahu akbar.
easy.explain: Istighfar is seeking forgiveness, commonly Astaghfirullah. Takbir is Allahu akbar.

statements: Surah Al-Kawthar is the shortest surah.
Surah Al-Baqarah is the longest.
Surah Al-Kawthar is the longest surah.
easy.explain: Al-Kawthar has three ayahs; Al-Baqarah has 286.

statements: Prophet Yusuf was thrown into a well by his brothers.
A surah is named after Yusuf.
Prophet Yusuf was thrown into a well by his father.
easy.explain: It was his brothers. His father Ya'qub grieved his loss for many years.

statements: Maryam is the mother of Isa.
Surah Maryam is named after her.
Maryam is the mother of Musa.
easy.explain: Maryam is the mother of Isa, ʿalayhi al-salām.

statements: Surah Al-Waqi'ah is surah 56.
Surah Al-Hadid is surah 57.
Surah Al-Mujadilah is surah 59.
medium.explain: Al-Mujadilah is surah 58. Surah 59 is Al-Hashr.

statements: Ghusl is the full washing of the body.
Wudu is the partial ablution.
Ghusl is required before every prayer.
medium.explain: Wudu is required before prayer. Ghusl is obligatory only in specific states.

statements: The Battle of the Camel was fought in Ali's caliphate.
Siffin was fought in Ali's caliphate.
The Battle of the Camel was fought in the Prophet's lifetime.
medium.explain: Both battles belong to the first fitnah, after the Prophet's passing, during Ali's caliphate.

statements: Al-Mu'awwidhatayn are Al-Falaq and An-Nas.
Both begin with 'Qul a'udhu'.
Al-Mu'awwidhatayn are Al-Ikhlas and Al-Falaq.
medium.explain: The two surahs of seeking refuge are Al-Falaq (113) and An-Nas (114). Al-Ikhlas precedes them.

statements: Juz 29 begins with Surah Al-Mulk.
Juz 30 begins with Surah An-Naba.
Juz 29 begins with Surah An-Naba.
medium.explain: An-Naba opens juz 30. Juz 29 begins with Al-Mulk.

statements: The miqat is where pilgrims enter ihram.
There are several mawaqit in different directions.
The miqat is the plain where pilgrims stand on the 9th.
medium.explain: That plain is Arafah. The mawaqit are boundary points where ihram is entered.

statements: Ramy al-Jamarat takes place at Mina.
Tawaf takes place at the Masjid al-Haram.
Ramy al-Jamarat takes place at Arafah.
medium.explain: The stoning of the pillars takes place at Mina, not Arafah.

statements: Surah Al-Jumu'ah is surah 62.
It commands leaving trade when the call is made.
It is a Makkan surah.
medium.explain: Surah Al-Jumu'ah is Madinan, as the Friday congregational prayer was established in Madinah.

statements: Taqwa is often rendered as God-consciousness.
Surah Al-Hujurat says the most honoured have the most taqwa.
Surah Al-Hujurat says the most honoured have the noblest lineage.
medium.explain: Al-Hujurat 49:13 states the opposite: honour lies in taqwa, not lineage.

statements: Shirk is associating partners with Allah.
Tawhid is the oneness of Allah.
Shirk and tawhid mean the same thing.
medium.explain: They are direct opposites: tawhid affirms oneness, shirk violates it.

statements: Surah An-Naba has 40 ayahs.
Surah An-Naba opens juz 30.
Surah An-Naba is a Madinan surah.
medium.explain: Surah An-Naba is Makkan, like most of juz 30.

statements: Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf was among the ten promised Paradise.
Umar appointed a council of six to choose his successor.
Umar appointed a council of ten to choose his successor.
medium.explain: The shura Umar appointed consisted of six senior companions.

statements: Sabr means patience.
Shukr means gratitude.
Sabr means gratitude.
medium.explain: Sabr is patience and steadfastness; shukr is gratitude.

statements: Surah Al-Hadid is named after iron.
It is surah 57.
It is named after a prophet.
medium.explain: Al-Hadid means 'the iron'. It is not named after a person.

statements: The Hijri calendar has twelve months.
Its first month is Muharram.
Its first month is Ramadan.
medium.explain: The year begins with Muharram. Ramadan is the ninth month.

statements: Umm Salamah had migrated to Abyssinia.
She gave decisive counsel at Hudaybiyyah.
She was the first wife of the Prophet ﷺ.
medium.explain: Khadijah was the Prophet's first wife. Umm Salamah married him in Madinah after the death of her husband Abu Salamah.

statements: Ikhlas means sincerity of intention.
Actions are judged by intentions, per a well-known hadith.
Ikhlas means patience in hardship.
medium.explain: Patience is sabr. Ikhlas is doing an act purely for Allah.

statements: Surah Al-Mujadilah concerns a woman who argued her case.
It is surah 58.
It concerns a woman who led an army.
medium.explain: The surah is named for the woman who disputed with the Prophet ﷺ concerning her husband.

statements: Zakat is due after a lunar year on qualifying wealth.
The nisab is the minimum threshold.
Zakat is due immediately on receiving any income.
medium.explain: Zakat on wealth requires a lunar year to pass over holdings above the nisab.

statements: Surah Al-Kahf has four main stories.
One concerns Musa and al-Khidr.
One concerns Yusuf and his brothers.
medium.explain: The story of Yusuf is in Surah Yusuf. Al-Kahf contains the cave sleepers, the two gardens, Musa and al-Khidr, and Dhul-Qarnayn.

statements: Surah Al-Ahzab is surah 33.
It contains the verse naming the Prophet ﷺ the seal of the prophets.
It is a Makkan surah.
hard.explain: Al-Ahzab is Madinan; it relates to the Confederates who besieged Madinah at Khandaq.

statements: Surah Al-Anfal relates largely to Badr.
Surah At-Tawbah follows it in the mushaf.
Surah Al-Anfal has 129 ayahs.
hard.explain: Al-Anfal has 75 ayahs. It is At-Tawbah that has 129.

statements: Surah Qaf is surah 50.
Surah Sad is surah 38.
Surah Nun is the common name of surah 67.
hard.explain: Surah Al-Qalam, which opens with the letter Nun, is surah 68. Surah 67 is Al-Mulk.

statements: Al-Sab' al-Tiwal begins with Al-Baqarah.
Its seventh member is disputed.
It consists of nine surahs.
hard.explain: The name means 'the seven long ones'. The dispute concerns which surah occupies the seventh place.

statements: Ibn Khaldun wrote the Muqaddimah.
He died in 1406 CE.
He wrote Tafsir al-Qur'an al-Azim.
hard.explain: That tafsir is Ibn Kathir's. Ibn Khaldun is known for the Muqaddimah and his universal history.

statements: Surah Al-Mumtahanah is surah 60.
Surah As-Saff is surah 61.
Surah Al-Hashr is surah 61.
hard.explain: Al-Hashr is surah 59. As-Saff is 61.

statements: Zayd ibn Thabit was of the Ansar.
He led the compilation under Abu Bakr.
He was among the Muhajirun.
hard.explain: He was from Madinah, and so of the Ansar rather than the emigrants from Makkah.

statements: The Saqifah gathering followed the Prophet's passing.
It concluded with allegiance to Abu Bakr.
It concluded with allegiance to Umar.
hard.explain: Abu Bakr was given the pledge at the Saqifah. Umar succeeded him two years later.

statements: Surah Muhammad is surah 47.
It is also called Surah al-Qital.
It is the only surah named after a prophet.
hard.explain: Six surahs are named after prophets. Surah Muhammad is the only one named after the Prophet ﷺ himself.

statements: Al-Mufassal is the final portion of the mushaf.
Scholars differ over where it begins.
Al-Mufassal is the opening portion of the mushaf.
hard.explain: Al-Mufassal is the concluding section of shorter surahs. The opening section is al-Sab' al-Tiwal.

statements: Muhkam and mutashabih are mentioned in Surah Al-Imran.
Muhkam verses are clear in meaning.
Mutashabih verses are the clear ones.
hard.explain: It is the reverse: muhkam are the clear verses, mutashabih those admitting more than one reading.

statements: Surah Al-Hujurat is surah 49.
Surah Qaf is surah 50.
Surah Adh-Dhariyat is surah 52.
hard.explain: Adh-Dhariyat is surah 51. Surah 52 is At-Tur.

statements: Abu Sufyan commanded at Uhud.
He accepted Islam at the conquest of Makkah.
He was killed at Badr.
hard.explain: Abu Jahl was killed at Badr. Abu Sufyan lived on and accepted Islam in 8 AH.

statements: Surah Ar-Ra'd is surah 13.
Surah Ibrahim is surah 14.
Surah Al-Hijr is surah 16.
hard.explain: Al-Hijr is surah 15. Surah 16 is An-Nahl.

statements: The first fitnah included Siffin.
It fell within Ali's caliphate.
It fell within Uthman's caliphate.
hard.explain: The first fitnah followed Uthman's killing and unfolded during Ali's caliphate.

statements: Surah Al-Fath has 29 ayahs.
It refers to Hudaybiyyah as a clear victory.
It has 129 ayahs.
hard.explain: Surah Al-Fath has 29 ayahs. At-Tawbah is the surah with 129.

statements: The Ridda campaigns took place under Abu Bakr.
They included the Battle of Yamamah.
They took place under Umar.
hard.explain: The Ridda campaigns fell within Abu Bakr's short caliphate, 11–13 AH.

statements: Surah Al-Ma'arij is surah 70.
Surah Nuh is surah 71.
Surah Al-Muzzammil is surah 72.
hard.explain: Al-Jinn is surah 72. Al-Muzzammil is 73.

statements: Surah Al-Insan is also called Surah Ad-Dahr.
Surah Al-Mursalat is surah 77.
Surah Al-Insan is surah 75.
hard.explain: Surah Al-Insan is surah 76. Surah 75 is Al-Qiyamah.

statements: Umar instituted the Hijri calendar.
Its year one corresponds to 622 CE.
Its year one corresponds to the year of the Prophet's birth.
hard.explain: The calendar counts from the year of the Hijrah, 622 CE, not from the Prophet's birth around 570 CE.
